notes.title: Pandemic: The Virus Outbreak 1.2.0 - Virtual reality update
notes.content:
Update Highlights:
- Added virtual reality support
[previewyoutube=7uNU8IQVUVU;full][/previewyoutube]
- Added a new tab that shows the statistics of the whole round
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37850343/12f529209aea6e94e7feeabc5021bc8fb0573fb9.png

- Improved influence of actions on statistics
- Improved influence of statistics on other statistics

notes.title: Pandemic 1.1.0
notes.content:
Update Highlights:

- If infections reach 0% the round goes on until a vaccine is developed
- If infections reach 80% (was 10% before) you get arrested by the international court
- If reputation reach 20% (was 40% before) your government is deposed
- If unemployment reach 70% (was 30% before) your government is deposed
- Improved statistics explanations
- Improved influence of actions on statistics
- Improved influence of statistics on other statistics
